setup: A conditional statement about complementary angles or about the angles of a triangle fixes the unknown angle.

steps.say: Complementary angles add to 90 degrees, so a complement is found by subtracting the known angle from 90.
The angles of a plane triangle add to 180 degrees, so the third angle is 180 minus the other two.
When two angles are each complementary to the same angle they are equal, so either one answers the question.
